answers.question: Thank you for calling Linden Grove Family Practice, this is the automated scheduling assistant. How can I help you today?
answers.answer: I need to cancel my physical appointment on Thursday morning.

answers.question: I'll help with that. Could you please provide the name and date of birth of the person who has the appointment?
answers.answer: My name is Tomas Lindqvist, T-O-M-A-S L-I-N-D-Q-V-I-S-T. My date of birth is July 4th, 1983.

answers.question: I have the name as Tomas Lindqvist. Is that correct?
You have an appointment for an annual physical with Dr. Sofia Alvarez on Thursday the 22nd at 9 AM. Is this the appointment you want to cancel?
answers.answer: Yes, please cancel that appointment. I will call again after my work trip to reschedule.
